messages:
Zara (People Ops): Heads-up: annual privacy & SOC2 attestation window opens today. Mandatory for all managers to submit signed attestation by May 3. :alarm_clock:
Zara (People Ops): Theres a new attestation form (fillable PDF) on Confluence + short how-to. Link: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PEOPLE/pages/Annual+Attestation
Jordan (Security): Reminder: Security needs the training completion CSVs exported from LMS with the exact header: employee_email,display_name,role,training_name,training_completed_at,cert_url. Well validate timestamps and cert URLs.
Eli (Engineering): Quick Q: If someones on parental leave, do they still need to be included?
Zara (People Ops): Include them but mark status in the CSV as "on_leave" in the role field or put a separate column "status". If they arent available to sign, manager can add a note in the attestation and mark as exception.
Maya (Legal): For teams working with sensitive customers, please highlight any non-disclosure addenda in the attestation. We may need to attach contract excerpts for the ISO workpaper.
okta-bot: Automated notice: LMS certificates will auto-sync to Okta learning profiles within 24 hours of completion. If not synced after 48 hours, contact people-ops@redwood.com.
Jordan (Security): Also: for SOC2 we need a snapshot of access control reviews for teams that manage keys or production infra. Attach a short line in the attestation with the review date.
Eli (Engineering): Understood. Will run access review for infra team and attach date.
Zara (People Ops): If anyone prefers, managers can use the portal uploader (link on Confluence) to upload all evidence in one zip. Make sure filenames follow the pattern: teamname_membername_cert.pdf.
Eli (Engineering): One more thing - what if a contractor is no longer active but completed training last quarter? Do we include them?
Maya (Legal): If the contractor is offboarded before the attestation window, include the completion record and mark them as "offboarded" in the CSV. Keep proof of completion in the uploads folder.
Jordan (Security): FYI: auditors will request sample evidence during the window (random picks). Keep originals; dont alter timestamps.
Zara (People Ops): Well send a reminder on Apr 28 to managers with missing uploads. If you have access issues, DM me.
Eli (Engineering): Thanks, well aim to have everything in by May 1. :thumbsup:
